name: @wealthai/astromatch
description: AstroMatch — the Chrome MV3 side-panel extension (docs/73 PH-39). Check a kundli match against your own chart from any page you are reading. It renders `@wealthai/astral` through `@wealthai/astral-dom` and talks to the same chatservice as the apps; it writes no astrology of its own and derives nothing.
